abstract: A 19-year-old man with mild mental retardation was diagnosed as having metastatic choriocarcinoma and a testicular tumor. Histopathological examination of the resected testis revealed the presence of a small lesion of mature teratoma but no trace of choriocarcinoma. The remaining seminiferous tubules were atrophic and lined by large atypical germ cells, which were diagnosed as intratubular germ cell neoplasia of the unclassified type (IGCNU). A small area with prominent tubules was also observed. Within this lesion, the tubules were dilated and contained several layers of cells with central necrosis. Immunohistological comparison of staining for several biological markers (Ki-67, c-kit and placental alkaline phosphatase) between cells in the atrophic tubules and those in the dilated tubules indicated a progression of the latter cells to cells with a more proliferative ability. In the opposite testis, examined at autopsy after death due to metastatic choriocarcinoma, all seminiferous tubules were lined by Sertoli cells only. It was therefore assumed that the germ cell tumor of the combined histological type had primarily arisen in the background of IGCNU, and that choriocarcinoma had spontaneously regressed. The early onset of these testicular neoplastic lesions strongly indicates their occurrence under the genetic background of gonadal dysplasia, the Sertoli cell-only syndrome. The possible relation of gonadal disease to mental retardation in this patient is also discussed.
abstract_ja: 19歳の男性（軽度の精神遅滞あり）が転移性絨毛癌および精巣腫瘍と診断された。切除された精巣の病理組織学的検査では、小さな成熟奇形腫の病変が認められたが、絨毛癌の痕跡はなかった。残存する精細管は萎縮しており、大型の異型胚細胞に覆われていた。これらは未分類型精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(IGCNU)と診断された。精細管が比較的保たれた小さな領域もみられた。この病変では、精細管が拡張し、中心壊死を伴う数層の細胞を含んでいた。萎縮精細管と拡張精細管の細胞について、Ki-67、c-kit、胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼの免疫組織化学染色を比較したところ、後者の細胞がより増殖能の高い細胞へと進展していることが示された。反対側の精巣は、患者の絨毛癌による死亡後の剖検で調べられ、全ての精細管がセルトリ細胞のみで覆われていた。したがって、この混合組織型の胚細胞腫瘍は主にIGCNUを背景に発生し、絨毛癌は自然退縮したと考えられた。これらの精巣病変の早期発症は、セルトリ細胞のみ症候群である性腺異形成という遺伝的背景を強く示唆する。この患者の精神遅滞と性腺疾患との関係についても考察した。
